styles.name: Whiteboard Marker
styles.look: Glossy white dry-erase board with a faint cool ceiling-light sheen and the ghost of an erased lesson. Chisel-tip marker strokes in black, blue and red with streaky ink and darker pooled ends; boxes and arrows are hand-traced twice and never perfectly closed.
styles.type: Hand-lettered marker caps (Permanent Marker or Caveat Brush), slightly uneven baseline.
styles.motion: Every line is drawn on with stroke-dashoffset in the order a presenter would draw it; a marker-tip dot leads each stroke. Slight 1-2px jitter on finished lines, never on drawing lines.
styles.transitions: Eraser wipe: a soft white smear sweeps across, leaving a faint ghost of the previous diagram.
styles.audio: Stroke speed follows narration pace; underline or circle the key word on vocal emphasis. On beats, add a quick tick/checkmark rather than motion of the whole frame.

styles.name: Chalkboard Lecture
styles.look: Slate-green chalkboard with layered dust smudges, half-erased formulas and a wooden ledge at the bottom. Chalk lines are dry and broken with grain gaps; colored chalk in pastel yellow, pink and blue for emphasis.
styles.type: Chalky rounded script for headings (Gochi Hand), small caps chalk print for labels.
styles.motion: Chalk strokes draw on with a grainy mask; small chalk dust particles puff where strokes end. Diagrams build piece by piece, top-left to bottom-right.
styles.transitions: Felt-eraser swipe in wide arcs that leaves cloudy residue.
styles.audio: Each new idea in narration triggers a new diagram element. Strong beats tap a chalk dot or underline.

styles.name: Notebook Doodle
styles.look: Spiral notebook page on blue-ruled or graph paper with a red margin line, coffee ring stain and slight page curl shadow. Ballpoint pen doodles with pressure variation, cross-hatching and margin stars.
styles.type: Neat student handwriting (Patrick Hand) with highlighter swipes behind key words.
styles.motion: Doodles sketch in quickly; little flip-book wiggles (2-3 frame boil) on characters. Highlighter sweeps left to right.
styles.transitions: Page flip with spiral-binding shadow, or tear-out reveal.
styles.audio: Doodle wiggles lock to the beat grid (boil every beat); highlighter sweeps on downbeats.

styles.name: Charcoal Sketch
styles.look: Heavy toothy cream paper, vine and compressed charcoal with smudged blending, finger-drag tonal areas and erased highlights. Raw construction lines left visible around figures.
styles.type: Condensed serif in charcoal black (Playfair Display SC), set sparse like gallery labels.
styles.motion: Slow reveals through smudge masks; forms emerge from loose gesture lines to finished tone. Gentle camera drift over paper.
styles.transitions: Charcoal smear dissolve, or paper turns to the next sheet in the sketchbook.
styles.audio: Energy drives smudge darkness and line density; quiet passages stay as gesture lines.

styles.name: Sumi Ink Brush
styles.look: Rice paper with visible fibers; single confident black ink brush strokes with dry-brush splitting, wet bleeding edges and generous negative space. One vermilion seal stamp as the only color.
styles.type: Elegant high-contrast serif or brush script, very small, placed asymmetrically.
styles.motion: Brush strokes paint on in one gesture each with ease-out; ink bleeds slowly outward after the stroke. Very few elements per scene.
styles.transitions: Ink drop spreads to fill the frame black, then recedes to reveal the next scene.
styles.audio: One stroke per phrase or per bar; stamp appears on the strongest hit. Silence is honored with stillness.

styles.name: Engineer's Notebook
styles.look: Cream engineering pad with faint green grid, mechanical pencil construction lines, dimension arrows, callout leaders and small annotations. Occasional red pencil correction.
styles.type: Technical lettering in all caps (Architects Daughter or IBM Plex Mono for numbers).
styles.motion: Construction lines draw first at low opacity, then the solid object traces over them; dimension arrows extend outward with values counting up.
styles.transitions: Pan across the pad to the next sketch; pencil eraser clears a region.
styles.audio: Counts and measurement ticks snap to beats; build phases follow song sections.

styles.name: Rotoscope Line Boil
styles.look: Flat off-white field with live, slightly trembling hand-inked contour lines around figures and objects (line boil). Spot fills of one or two flat colors, no shading.
styles.type: Bold hand-drawn grotesque lettering that boils with the lines.
styles.motion: Everything boils at 8-12 drawings per second (step the timeline with stepped ease) to feel hand-animated; figures move with snappy poses.
styles.transitions: Lines unravel into a single scribble that redraws as the next scene.
styles.audio: Boil rate doubles in high-energy sections; poses snap on beats.

styles.name: Watercolor Wash
styles.look: Cold-press paper texture with transparent glazes built in many soft layers: darker dried edges, wet-in-wet bleeds, granulating pigment and blooms. Lights are untouched paper; a faint graphite under-sketch shows through.
styles.type: Light humanist serif (Cormorant Garamond) or delicate script, ink-colored.
styles.motion: Shapes appear by washes spreading from a center with soft feathered masks; colors deepen in passes. Slow parallax between paper layers.
styles.transitions: A wet wash floods across and dries into the next composition.
styles.audio: Bloom size and saturation follow energy; new washes drop on downbeats; quiet sections stay pale.

styles.name: Oil Impasto
styles.look: Thick buttery oil paint with raking light catching ridges, palette-knife slabs and visible bristle tracks; rich chiaroscuro and warm varnish glow.
styles.type: Classic old-style serif (EB Garamond) in gold leaf tone.
styles.motion: Slow push-ins; brush strokes visibly lay down to reveal forms; subtle shimmer in highlights as light rakes across.
styles.transitions: Knife-scrape wipe, or dissolve through wet paint smear.
styles.audio: Light intensity and stroke rhythm follow energy; big hits slam a heavy knife stroke.

styles.name: Gouache Storybook
styles.look: Opaque matte gouache with flat chalky color, dry-brush texture at edges and simple rounded shapes; picture-book composition with cozy interiors and warm light.
styles.type: Friendly rounded serif (Fraunces Soft) set like a picture-book page.
styles.motion: Cut-out style limited animation: characters move on simple arcs, blink, bob; background layers drift in parallax.
styles.transitions: Page turn or iris through a painted shape.
styles.audio: Characters bob on the beat; scene changes on phrase boundaries.

styles.name: Soft Pastel
styles.look: Velvety chalk pastel on toned paper, blended gradients with visible paper tooth, dreamy haze and powder edges.
styles.type: Airy thin sans (Quicksand Light) with generous tracking.
styles.motion: Floating, weightless drifts; elements fade through powder masks; slow breathing scale.
styles.transitions: Powder cloud cross-dissolve.
styles.audio: Haze density breathes with the sustained pad energy; light sparkles on hi-hats.

styles.name: Fresco Plaster
styles.look: Pigment soaked into cracked lime plaster with faded earth tones, chipped edges revealing brick beneath, and gilded halos.
styles.type: Roman inscriptional capitals (Cinzel) carved into the plaster.
styles.motion: Slow reveal of sections as if restorers uncover them; gentle camera dolly along a wall.
styles.transitions: Plaster flakes away to reveal the next panel.
styles.audio: Sections uncover on phrase changes; gold glints on big hits.

styles.name: Spray-Paint Mural
styles.look: Brick or concrete wall with aerosol fades, overspray halos, drips, crisp stencil edges and bold outlines; sun-bleached posters peeking at edges.
styles.type: Wildstyle-inspired chunky letters for titles, stencil caps for labels.
styles.motion: Paint sprays on with soft-edged masks and drips running down after; camera handheld sway.
styles.transitions: Roller buff paints over the wall in a fresh color.
styles.audio: Spray bursts on snares; drips on kick; colors swap per section.

styles.name: Halftone Pop Panel
styles.look: Blown-up comic panel: thick tapered black ink outlines, mechanical dot screens in primary red and blue, flat yellow fills, speech balloons and burst captions, slight misregistration.
styles.type: Comic lettering (Bangers) in balloons; caption boxes in yellow.
styles.motion: Panels slam in with overshoot; dot screens scroll subtly; action lines and impact bursts pop on emphasis.
styles.transitions: Panel-to-panel gutter slide or a big BAM burst wipe.
styles.audio: Impact bursts on kicks/snares; balloons pop with each vocal phrase.

styles.name: Risograph Duotone
styles.look: Soy-ink riso print in two or three spot colors with grainy coverage, overprint blending, registration drift and paper speckle.
styles.type: Chunky grotesk (Archivo Black) overprinted in a spot color.
styles.motion: Layers slide independently by a few pixels (registration wobble); shapes stamp in with a slight squash.
styles.transitions: Color plates separate and re-register into the next layout.
styles.audio: Registration wobble amount follows energy; plate swaps on downbeats.

styles.name: Linocut Relief
styles.look: Bold carved relief print: white gouge marks, chunky black shapes, uneven ink coverage and paper texture showing through; one accent color pass.
styles.type: Carved-looking slab serif with irregular edges.
styles.motion: Carving reveals: gouge strokes cut away black to reveal white; stamp-press impacts with slight shake.
styles.transitions: Brayer roll inks the next block across the frame.
styles.audio: Stamp presses on kicks; carving speed follows tempo.

styles.name: Screenprint Gig Poster
styles.look: Hand-pulled screenprint with flat bold layers, slight ink texture, halftone gradients and a limited flashy palette on cream stock.
styles.type: Display condensed poster type (Bebas Neue) with stacked lineup hierarchy.
styles.motion: Each ink layer pulls in with a squeegee sweep; illustration elements loop subtly.
styles.transitions: Squeegee pull reveals the next print.
styles.audio: Headliner name hits on the drop; layers lock to bars.

styles.name: Edo Woodblock
styles.look: Traditional woodblock print: keyline outlines, flat color blocks with wood-grain texture, bokashi gradient skies, stylized waves and clouds, washi paper.
styles.type: Vertical cartouche labels; refined serif for English.
styles.motion: Parallax layers of waves and clouds; color blocks print in sequence; gentle looping water.
styles.transitions: Scroll unrolls horizontally to the next scene.
styles.audio: Wave crests time to beats; gradient skies shift with sections.

styles.name: Letterpress Type
styles.look: Deep debossed metal and wood type on thick cotton paper, ink squeeze at edges, slight unevenness; ornaments and rules.
styles.type: Wood-type display faces mixed with classic serif; type is the hero.
styles.motion: Words press in with a deboss shadow and tiny bounce; ornaments slide into lockup.
styles.transitions: Platen press closes and opens on the next sheet.
styles.audio: One word per beat for lyric or quote sequences.

styles.name: Shadow Puppet Theatre
styles.look: Black cut-out silhouettes with ornate punched cut-work, pin joints and thin control rods, pressed against a backlit cloth screen glowing amber at center and falling to deep red-brown at the edges; colored gel panels fill some openings.
styles.type: Ornamental serif in silhouette, cut out of the scenery.
styles.motion: Puppets move on rods with hinged limbs and slight sway; they press closer to the screen (sharper) or pull back (softer, larger).
styles.transitions: Lamp flickers down and up, or a curtain silhouette sweeps across.
styles.audio: Lamp flicker breathes with energy; puppet gestures land on beats; narration drives scene order.

styles.name: Layered Paper Diorama
styles.look: Stacked colored cardstock layers cut into landscapes and cities, real drop shadows between layers, soft top light and tiny paper details.
styles.type: Paper-cut letters with thickness and shadow (Rubik).
styles.motion: Deep parallax dolly through layers; elements pop up like a pop-up book with hinge rotation.
styles.transitions: Layers fold flat and unfold into the next scene.
styles.audio: Pop-ups on beats; camera depth pushes on builds.

styles.name: Claymation Stop-Motion
styles.look: Handmade plasticine characters with fingerprints, soft subsurface sheen and slightly imperfect shapes on a tabletop set; warm practical lighting.
styles.type: Clay-rolled chunky letters.
styles.motion: Stepped animation on twos (12fps feel), squash-and-stretch, tiny frame-to-frame jitter.
styles.transitions: Clay squish morph from one shape into the next.
styles.audio: Squash on kicks; characters lip-flap to vocal energy.

styles.name: Felt & Fabric
styles.look: Felt shapes with fuzzy edges, visible blanket stitching, buttons, yarn lines and denim or corduroy backgrounds.
styles.type: Stitched or embroidered lettering.
styles.motion: Pieces flop on like felt-board cutouts; yarn lines draw as stitches.
styles.transitions: Fabric curtain pull or zipper reveal.
styles.audio: Stitches advance per beat; soft bounce on kicks.

styles.name: Origami Fold
styles.look: Crisp folded paper forms with sharp creases, faceted light and shadow, subtle paper fiber, on a clean gradient sweep.
styles.type: Geometric sans (Montserrat) with folded-corner accents.
styles.motion: Objects fold and unfold along creases (3D CSS rotations), transforming one form into another.
styles.transitions: The frame folds into a paper crane that flies off, revealing the next scene.
styles.audio: Each fold lands on a beat; full transformations on bars.

styles.name: Cardboard Prototype
styles.look: Corrugated cardboard cut-outs, masking tape, marker labels, hot-glue blobs and box-cutter edges on a workbench.
styles.type: Thick marker labels on tape strips.
styles.motion: Pieces get taped and assembled; hand-cranked mechanisms turn.
styles.transitions: Box flaps open into the next scene.
styles.audio: Assembly steps on beats; crank speed matches tempo.

styles.name: Kente Patchwork
styles.look: Woven strip textiles with bold geometric blocks, gold thread sheen, wax-print patterns and quilt seams; fabric weave visible up close.
styles.type: Strong geometric display type (Syne ExtraBold) on woven bands.
styles.motion: Strips weave in over and under; patterns slide along warp and weft; quilt blocks flip in grid order.
styles.transitions: A woven band sweeps across and unravels into the next scene.
styles.audio: Weave rhythm locks to drum patterns; block flips on kicks.

styles.name: Illuminated Manuscript
styles.look: Book-of-hours page on mottled vellum with ruling lines, blackletter text in iron-gall ink with red headings, a large decorated initial on raised burnished gold, lapis and malachite pigments with white filigree, vine borders and whimsical margin creatures.
styles.type: Blackletter (UnifrakturMaguntia) for headings; humanist serif for readable body.
styles.motion: Gold leaf glints with a moving specular; vines grow around the border; margin creatures animate in small loops.
styles.transitions: Turn of the vellum page with a candle-lit shadow.
styles.audio: Gold glints on accents; new lines of text ink in with each phrase.

styles.name: Picture Book
styles.look: Warm children's book illustration with soft colored pencil over flat color, expressive round characters, cozy rooms and gentle textures.
styles.type: Round friendly serif (Baloo 2), big and readable.
styles.motion: Characters wobble-walk, blink and wave; props bounce in; camera gently pans across spreads.
styles.transitions: Turn the page.
styles.audio: Bouncy movement on beats; read-along word highlights follow narration.

styles.name: Mid-Century Cartoon
styles.look: 1950s limited animation: angular stylized characters, flat offset color blocks that miss the lines, atomic starbursts, boomerang shapes and textured backgrounds.
styles.type: Jaunty mid-century script and condensed sans (Lobster + Oswald).
styles.motion: Snappy holds with fast transitions between key poses; backgrounds slide on loops.
styles.transitions: Starburst iris or color-field wipe.
styles.audio: Pose snaps on beats; jazz swing timing.

styles.name: Anime Cel
styles.look: Clean cel-shaded characters with two-tone shadows, sharp highlights, detailed painted backgrounds, speed lines and lens flares.
styles.type: Bold italic sans with outline stroke for impact titles.
styles.motion: Limited animation with dramatic held frames, smear frames, speed-line bursts and quick camera shakes.
styles.transitions: White flash or diagonal slash wipe.
styles.audio: Impact frames and flashes on drops; speed lines during builds.

styles.name: Ligne Claire Comic
styles.look: Clear-line European comic style: uniform thin black outlines, flat bright colors, no hatching, precise backgrounds and readable panels.
styles.type: Clean hand-lettered comic caps.
styles.motion: Panel-by-panel camera moves across a page; characters move in clean simple poses.
styles.transitions: Camera glides across the gutter into the next panel.
styles.audio: Panel changes on phrases; sound-effect lettering on hits.

styles.name: Afrofuturist Illustration
styles.look: Regal Black characters in luminous future attire, adinkra and geometric motifs as technology, gold and indigo gradients, cosmic skies and sleek architecture.
styles.type: Futuristic geometric display (Orbitron or Syncopate) with gold gradients.
styles.motion: Symbols activate with light pulses; slow heroic push-ins; particles of gold rise.
styles.transitions: Geometric portal opens with gold light.
styles.audio: Symbol pulses on beats; portal opens on the drop.

styles.name: Botanical Plate
styles.look: Victorian scientific illustration: fine engraved line, delicate watercolor tint, specimen labels, Latin captions and numbered parts on aged paper.
styles.type: Small italic serif labels; numbered callouts.
styles.motion: Specimens draw in line by line, then tint; callout leaders extend to labels.
styles.transitions: Pan to the next plate in the folio.
styles.audio: Labels appear on beats; gentle classical pacing.

styles.name: Bauhaus Geometry
styles.look: Primary-color circles, squares and triangles on off-white, strong diagonals, thick black bars and functional asymmetric balance.
styles.type: Geometric sans (Futura-like: Jost) lowercase, rotated 90° in places.
styles.motion: Shapes roll, slide and stack with mechanical easing; elements rotate in 90° steps.
styles.transitions: Shapes recompose into the next layout.
styles.audio: Each shape moves on a specific drum voice (kick=circle, snare=square, hat=triangle).

styles.name: Swiss International Grid
styles.look: Strict modular grid, huge flush-left sans type, generous white space, a single red accent and objective photography crops.
styles.type: Neo-grotesk (Inter Tight or Helvetica-like) at extreme scale contrast.
styles.motion: Type and blocks slide along grid lines with precise ease; counters tick; nothing decorative.
styles.transitions: Grid columns wipe across.
styles.audio: Movement quantized to the beat grid; text changes on bars.

styles.name: Art Deco Gilded
styles.look: Black lacquer and champagne gold, sunbursts, stepped ziggurat frames, fan motifs, marble and chrome; 1920s glamour.
styles.type: Deco display (Poiret One or Limelight) with wide tracking.
styles.motion: Symmetric reveals from center; gold lines trace frames; sunbursts rotate slowly.
styles.transitions: Fan opens or deco doors part.
styles.audio: Gold line traces on horn hits; sunburst spins with energy.

styles.name: Constructivist Poster
styles.look: Bold diagonals, red and black on cream, photomontage cutouts, megaphone graphics, arrows and blocky type.
styles.type: Heavy condensed sans in diagonal stacks.
styles.motion: Hard slam-ins along diagonals; type blocks punch forward; camera tilts.
styles.transitions: Diagonal block slices.
styles.audio: Slams on kicks; type punches on vocal accents.

styles.name: Memphis Pattern
styles.look: 1980s Memphis design: squiggles, confetti dots, terrazzo, zigzags and pastel plus neon shapes with thick black outlines.
styles.type: Playful geometric display with drop shadows.
styles.motion: Shapes bounce, spin and scatter; patterns scroll; elastic easing.
styles.transitions: Confetti burst or squiggle wipe.
styles.audio: Bounces on every beat; confetti on drops.

styles.name: Harlem Renaissance Silhouette
styles.look: Layered silhouetted figures in concentric light rings, cubist geometry, muted violet, sienna and gold tonal bands; jazz, labor and uplift themes.
styles.type: Elegant deco-influenced serif.
styles.motion: Concentric rings radiate outward; silhouettes rise and gesture; tonal bands shift.
styles.transitions: Rings expand to fill the frame with the next tone.
styles.audio: Rings pulse with bass; figures move with the swing.

styles.name: 8-Bit Pixel
styles.look: Low-res pixel art on a limited NES-like palette, chunky sprites, tile maps, scanline-free crisp pixels (image-rendering: pixelated).
styles.type: Pixel font (Press Start 2P).
styles.motion: Sprite frame animation in steps; movement snaps to the pixel grid; score counters tick.
styles.transitions: Pixel dissolve or screen-wipe like a level change.
styles.audio: Sprites jump on beats; chiptune-style blips on hits.

styles.name: 16-Bit RPG
styles.look: Lush 16-bit pixel landscapes with parallax layers, dialog boxes with blue gradients, menu cursors and stat bars.
styles.type: Pixel serif dialog font; typewriter text reveal.
styles.motion: Parallax scrolling scenes; dialog text types out; HP/XP bars fill.
styles.transitions: Battle-swirl or mosaic transition.
styles.audio: Text speed follows narration; level-up flash on drops.

styles.name: Vaporwave
styles.look: Pastel pink and teal gradients, marble busts, palm trees, checkerboard floors, old OS windows, Japanese katakana accents and VHS tracking.
styles.type: Wide serif or chrome italic with glow.
styles.motion: Slow floating loops, rotating busts, drifting windows, VHS jitter.
styles.transitions: VHS rewind glitch.
styles.audio: Slowed pacing; jitter on snares; color shifts on pads.

styles.name: Y2K Chrome
styles.look: Liquid chrome blobs, iridescent bubbles, futuristic gloss, stars and tribal swooshes, lens flares, translucent plastic.
styles.type: Chrome-beveled futuristic type with sparkle glints.
styles.motion: Blobby morphs, spinning chrome logos, glint sweeps.
styles.transitions: Chrome splash wipe.
styles.audio: Glints on hats; morphs breathe with bass.

styles.name: Early Web Homepage
styles.look: 1990s personal homepage: tiled starfield backgrounds, under-construction gifs, hit counters, beveled buttons, marquee text and web-safe colors.
styles.type: Times and Comic-style system fonts, blinking text.
styles.motion: Marquees scroll, gifs loop, counters roll.
styles.transitions: Page loads line by line like a slow modem.
styles.audio: Blinks and gif frames on beats.

styles.name: Low-Poly PS1
styles.look: Late-90s console 3D: low polygon models, wobbly affine textures, vertex jitter, fog and dithering.
styles.type: Chunky beveled title text.
styles.motion: Stiff rotations, vertex jitter, slow orbiting camera.
styles.transitions: Loading-screen fade with spinning icon.
styles.audio: Camera orbit speed follows tempo; jitter on hits.

styles.name: ASCII Art
styles.look: Images built from monospaced characters on black; density ramps form shading; occasional color ANSI accents.
styles.type: Monospace (JetBrains Mono).
styles.motion: Characters re-roll like a cipher before resolving; scanning reveals.
styles.transitions: Character rain clears the screen.
styles.audio: Character density follows energy; re-rolls on beats.

styles.name: Synthwave Grid
styles.look: Magenta-to-purple sunset with a striped sun, neon wireframe grid floor racing toward the horizon, chrome text and star fields.
styles.type: Chrome italic display with neon outline (Monoton or Audiowide).
styles.motion: Grid scrolls forward continuously; sun shimmers; titles sweep with glint.
styles.transitions: Neon flash and grid warp.
styles.audio: Grid speed = tempo; sun pulses with kick; glints on snares.

styles.name: CRT Green Terminal
styles.look: Curved phosphor screen with green text, scanlines, bloom, slight barrel distortion and flicker.
styles.type: VT323 monospace.
styles.motion: Typewriter output with blinking cursor; scroll and line feeds.
styles.transitions: CRT power-off collapse to a line, then on.
styles.audio: Typing cadence follows narration syllables.

styles.name: Classic Desktop UI
styles.look: Mid-90s desktop: teal background, gray beveled windows, title bars, error dialogs, hourglass cursor and pixel icons.
styles.type: Pixel system sans.
styles.motion: Windows pop open, drag and cascade; progress bars crawl.
styles.transitions: Window minimize to taskbar.
styles.audio: Dialogs pop on beats; error stacks on drops.

styles.name: Arcade Attract Mode
styles.look: Arcade cabinet bezel art, blinking INSERT COIN, high-score tables, vector-glow graphics and starbursts.
styles.type: Arcade pixel and vector fonts.
styles.motion: Blinking prompts, scrolling high scores, vector shapes spinning.
styles.transitions: Coin drop flash.
styles.audio: Blinks on beats; score jumps on drops.

styles.name: Neon Sign Tubes
styles.look: Bent glass neon tubes on a dark brick wall, glow halos, mounting clips, wiring and a buzzing flicker.
styles.type: Neon script and monoline type.
styles.motion: Tubes ignite segment by segment with flicker; occasional dropout.
styles.transitions: Lights out, next sign flickers on.
styles.audio: Ignite on beats; flicker on hats; full glow on chorus.

styles.name: Cyberpunk HUD
styles.look: Holographic heads-up display: scanning reticles, data readouts, corner brackets, glitch artifacts, cyan and magenta on dark rain-streaked city.
styles.type: Technical condensed mono (Rajdhani / Share Tech Mono).
styles.motion: Brackets lock on targets; numbers stream; glitch slices.
styles.transitions: Digital glitch tear.
styles.audio: Lock-ons on kicks; glitch on snares; data stream speed = energy.

styles.name: Isometric Pastel
styles.look: Clean vector isometric scene in true 30° projection: three-tone flat face shading, soft pastel palette with one coral accent, tiny people for scale and long soft shadows on a floating tile.
styles.type: Rounded geometric sans (Nunito), labels on isometric planes.
styles.motion: Blocks rise from the tile, pieces slide along iso axes, tiny people walk loops.
styles.transitions: Camera rotates around the tile or tiles connect into a bigger world.
styles.audio: Blocks rise on beats; new tiles on bars.

styles.name: Soft Clay 3D
styles.look: Matte soft-plastic 3D renders with rounded edges, pastel ambient occlusion, gentle studio lighting and toy-like proportions.
styles.type: Puffy rounded display type.
styles.motion: Bouncy springs, wobble physics, objects pop with squash.
styles.transitions: Objects squish into each other.
styles.audio: Springs bounce on kicks.

styles.name: Glass Layers
styles.look: Frosted glass panels with backdrop blur floating over vivid gradient blobs, thin white borders, soft shadows and depth stacking.
styles.type: Modern sans (Manrope), white with subtle shadow.
styles.motion: Panels float on independent depths; gradients drift; cards slide in with blur ramps.
styles.transitions: Panels stack and slide off.
styles.audio: Gradient blobs pulse with bass; cards on beats.

styles.name: Voxel World
styles.look: Cube-built 3D worlds with bright colors, chunky shadows and tiny voxel characters.
styles.type: Blocky pixel 3D lettering.
styles.motion: Voxels assemble cube by cube; camera orbits the build.
styles.transitions: World crumbles into cubes and rebuilds.
styles.audio: Cubes drop per beat.

styles.name: Exploded View Tech
styles.look: Precise 3D exploded product diagram on dark gradient: components separated along an axis with thin callout lines, specular metal and glass.
styles.type: Technical sans with hairline callouts.
styles.motion: Assembly explodes apart, labels draw on, reassembles.
styles.transitions: Parts fly to form the next object.
styles.audio: Separation on build; reassembly on drop.

styles.name: Tilt-Shift Miniature
styles.look: Real-world scenes rendered like tiny models: strong depth-of-field blur bands, saturated colors, high viewpoint.
styles.type: Clean bold sans labels with pin markers.
styles.motion: Sped-up tiny traffic and people; focus band shifts.
styles.transitions: Focus pull to the next location.
styles.audio: Time-lapse speed follows tempo.

styles.name: 1940s Film Noir
styles.look: High-contrast black-and-white: venetian-blind light slats, a fedora silhouette, a single practical light source, smoke hanging in beams, heavy film grain, gate weave, dust and scratches.
styles.type: Bold condensed serif title cards with drop shadow.
styles.motion: Slow dolly moves, shadows sliding across walls, smoke drifting; flicker and gate weave constant.
styles.transitions: Iris out or hard cut with a flash of light.
styles.audio: Light flicker follows bass; dramatic stings trigger hard light changes.

styles.name: Bioluminescent Deep Sea
styles.look: Near-black ocean with drifting marine snow in parallax; the only light is living light: glowing jellyfish nerve nets, siphonophore chains, rainbow comb rows, an angler lure. Additive cyan, teal and electric blue with magenta and amber accents.
styles.type: Thin glowing sans that pulses like the creatures (Exo 2 Light).
styles.motion: Slow pulsing, gentle drifting; light travels along nerve-net paths like data.
styles.transitions: Darkness swallows, then a new organism lights up.
styles.audio: Pulses follow kick; glow intensity follows energy; ripple trails on vocals.

styles.name: Golden Hour 35mm
styles.look: Warm 35mm film look: halation around highlights, soft grain, lifted blacks, lens flare and sun-drenched backlight.
styles.type: Light serif lower thirds (Libre Baskerville Italic).
styles.motion: Handheld drift, slow push-ins, flares sweeping.
styles.transitions: Light leak burn.
styles.audio: Light leaks on chorus; drift calms in verses.

styles.name: Thermal Infrared
styles.look: False-color thermal imaging: iron palette from black-purple through orange to white-hot, temperature readouts and crosshair overlays.
styles.type: Mono readout text with temperature units.
styles.motion: Heat signatures bloom and cool; scanning crosshair.
styles.transitions: Palette shift sweep.
styles.audio: Heat follows energy; flares on drops.

styles.name: X-Ray Lightbox
styles.look: Glowing blue-white radiograph films clipped to a lightbox, translucent internal structures, labels and grease-pencil marks.
styles.type: Clinical mono labels.
styles.motion: Films slide onto the lightbox; inner layers fade in; grease pencil circles.
styles.transitions: Lightbox flicker to the next film.
styles.audio: Reveals on beats.

styles.name: Long-Exposure Light Painting
styles.look: Night scene with luminous light trails drawn through the air, sparks, star trails and glowing ribbons over dark landscapes.
styles.type: Light-trail script that writes itself.
styles.motion: Trails draw continuously with soft fall-off; sparks scatter.
styles.transitions: Trail sweeps the frame to reveal the next.
styles.audio: Trail speed follows tempo; sparks on hats.

styles.name: Cyanotype Darkroom
styles.look: Prussian-blue sun prints with white botanical and object silhouettes, brush-edge coating and paper texture.
styles.type: Typewriter labels on white tape.
styles.motion: Prints develop from pale to deep blue; objects lift away revealing silhouettes.
styles.transitions: Rinse wash across the sheet.
styles.audio: Develop speed follows energy.

styles.name: Market Terminal
styles.look: Dense financial terminal: black background, amber and green numbers, tickers, candlestick charts, panels with function keys.
styles.type: Condensed mono for numbers (IBM Plex Mono).
styles.motion: Tickers scroll, numbers roll, candles grow, alerts flash.
styles.transitions: Panel swaps like function-key screens.
styles.audio: Number rolls on beats; alerts on hits.

styles.name: Editorial Data Graphics
styles.look: Newspaper-grade charts: clean axes, annotated lines, muted palette with one highlight color, serif headlines and source notes.
styles.type: Serif headline (Source Serif) + sans labels (Source Sans).
styles.motion: Lines draw along time, bars grow from baseline, annotations fade in with leader lines.
styles.transitions: Chart morphs into the next chart form.
styles.audio: Data reveals paced by narration; highlights on emphasis.

styles.name: Transit Map Diagram
styles.look: Subway-map schematic: 45° lines in bold colors, station dots, interchanges and a clean legend.
styles.type: Transport sans (Overpass) station labels.
styles.motion: Lines extend station to station; a train dot travels the route.
styles.transitions: Zoom along a line to the next map.
styles.audio: Stations light on beats.

styles.name: Icon Infographic
styles.look: Flat icon system with pictograms, big numbers, rounded cards and soft brand colors on light background.
styles.type: Geometric sans with oversized numerals (Poppins).
styles.motion: Icons pop in, numbers count up, pictogram arrays fill.
styles.transitions: Card slide carousel.
styles.audio: Counts land on beats.

styles.name: Scientific Journal Figure
styles.look: Academic figure panels labeled A-D, error bars, scatter plots, minimal gridlines and small caption text on white.
styles.type: Small sans (Helvetica-like) captions and panel letters.
styles.motion: Panels reveal in order, points scatter in, fit lines draw.
styles.transitions: Next figure slides in.
styles.audio: Restrained; reveals per narration sentence.

styles.name: KPI Dashboard Motion
styles.look: Dark modern dashboard: KPI tiles, sparklines, donut gauges, status chips and subtle glow on key numbers.
styles.type: Inter for labels, tabular numerals for metrics.
styles.motion: Tiles assemble, gauges sweep, sparklines draw, numbers count.
styles.transitions: Dashboard pans to the next panel.
styles.audio: Metric updates on beats; status chips flip on hits.

styles.name: Kinetic Typography
styles.look: Type-only frames on solid or duotone backgrounds; words scale, stack, rotate and fill the frame with bold contrast.
styles.type: Heavy variable grotesk (Anton / Inter Black) with extreme scale shifts.
styles.motion: Words slam, slide, flip and stack phrase by phrase; emphasis words get color and scale.
styles.transitions: A word grows to fill the frame and becomes the next background.
styles.audio: One word or phrase per beat; emphasis on stressed syllables; drop = biggest word.

styles.name: Particle Field
styles.look: Thousands of glowing particles on dark space forming logos, faces and words, then dispersing into flowing clouds.
styles.type: Thin modern sans assembled from particles.
styles.motion: Particles swarm into shapes (seeded positions for determinism) and explode outward.
styles.transitions: Disperse and reform as the next shape.
styles.audio: Particle speed and spread follow energy; reform on downbeats.

styles.name: Flow Field Lines
styles.look: Thousands of fine curved lines following a noise flow field, like wind or magnetism, in a limited elegant palette.
styles.type: Elegant light serif overlay.
styles.motion: Lines advect continuously along the field; field morphs slowly (seeded noise).
styles.transitions: Field direction flips, revealing the next composition.
styles.audio: Field turbulence follows energy; color shifts on sections.

styles.name: Generative Mosaic Grid
styles.look: A tile grid where each cell holds a shape, glyph or color that flips and recombines; Truchet tiles and pattern logic.
styles.type: Monospace or geometric glyphs inside cells.
styles.motion: Waves of cell flips sweep across; patterns resolve into images or words.
styles.transitions: Cell cascade reveal.
styles.audio: Flip waves triggered by beats; density with energy.

styles.name: Variable Font Morph
styles.look: Large letterforms whose weight, width and slant morph fluidly; minimal backgrounds with soft gradient light.
styles.type: A variable font (Roboto Flex or Fraunces) animated across axes.
styles.motion: Font axes tween with GSAP on CSS font-variation-settings; letters breathe and stretch.
styles.transitions: Word squeezes to a line and expands into the next.
styles.audio: Weight follows energy; width follows bass.

styles.name: Lyric Caption Karaoke
styles.look: Full-screen lyric display over a blurred or gradient background; current line bright, next line dim; word-by-word fill highlight.
styles.type: Bold rounded sans (Poppins ExtraBold) centered.
styles.motion: Lines roll up; words fill left to right in sync; background breathes.
styles.transitions: Line roll to the next verse; chorus gets a color change.
styles.audio: Requires word timestamps (transcribe step); fills exactly on word onsets; chorus color swap.

styles.name: Flat-Vector Science
styles.look: Science-explainer vector art: deep navy-to-violet space gradients, chunky outline-free shapes with rich multi-stop gradients, crescent shadows and rim highlights, soft radial glows, sparkling stars, banded ringed planets and cute round characters with big eyes.
styles.type: Bold rounded sans (Nunito Black) with soft shadow.
styles.motion: Smooth, bouncy character animation; planets orbit; stars twinkle; diagrams assemble with spring.
styles.transitions: Zoom through a planet or star into the next scene.
styles.audio: Twinkle on hats; character reactions on vocal emphasis; orbit speed with tempo.

styles.name: Tech Glow Explainer
styles.look: Polished AI/tech YouTube look: deep navy-indigo space with drifting electric glows and a perspective grid, gradient-stroked icon tiles wired into node diagrams with light pulses racing along connectors, dark cards with thin neon borders, gradient headline type and bloom on bright elements.
styles.type: Inter / Space Grotesk headings with gradient fill.
styles.motion: Nodes connect, pulses travel paths, cards slide with blur, numbers count; subtle camera parallax.
styles.transitions: Zoom into a node to reveal its inner diagram.
styles.audio: Pulses fire on beats; node activations on hits; glow follows energy.

styles.name: Papercraft Models
styles.look: Printed cardstock kit models — boxy low-poly robots, animals and charts — with printed faces, dotted fold lines, glue tabs and hairline seams, lit by a warm key light on a green cutting mat with craft tools at the edges.
styles.type: Printed label type on paper tags (Space Mono).
styles.motion: Models fold up from flat sheets, rotate on the mat, hinge-animate.
styles.transitions: Model unfolds flat; next sheet folds up.
styles.audio: Folds on beats; completion pop on bar ends.

styles.name: Manim-Style Math
styles.look: Pure black background, crisp anti-aliased vector lines, restrained blue, teal, yellow, red and green palette, italic serif math, axes with ticks, curves, arrows, braces and highlight rectangles (the open-source Manim look).
styles.type: Computer Modern-style serif (CMU Serif / KaTeX fonts) for math; italics for variables.
styles.motion: Write-on strokes, transforms between equations, graphs plotting, smooth camera zooms.
styles.transitions: Equation transforms into the next concept.
styles.audio: Restrained: steps follow narration; key reveals land on emphasis.

styles.name: Editorial Essay Collage
styles.look: Animated video-essay collage: warm grainy paper, archival halftone photos with torn white borders and soft shadows, newspaper clippings with yellow highlighter sweeps, masking tape, flat color blocks and big cut-out condensed headlines.
styles.type: Condensed cut-out headlines (Oswald) + serif clipping text (Merriweather).
styles.motion: Cutouts slide and tape down, highlighter sweeps, photos pan Ken-Burns style.
styles.transitions: Paper tear or new clipping slaps on top.
styles.audio: Cutouts land on beats; highlighter on emphasized words.

styles.name: Product Launch Reveal
styles.look: Keynote product film: one glossy hero object on a near-black stage with soft key, rim light, sweeping specular highlight and floor reflection; huge tight-tracked headlines, gradient key numbers with soft glow and hairline spec callouts.
styles.type: Tight-tracked neo-grotesk (Inter Display) at massive scale.
styles.motion: Slow hero rotation, specular sweeps, numbers count with glow, callouts draw.
styles.transitions: Fade to black then reveal; light sweep wipe.
styles.audio: Big reveals on drops; specular sweeps on swells.

styles.name: Social Short Captions
styles.look: Vertical-first short-form: bold auto-captions with word highlight, emoji pops, punchy zooms, progress bar and sticker callouts over footage or brand backgrounds.
styles.type: Heavy sans captions (Montserrat Black) with thick stroke.
styles.motion: Caption words pop with scale; jump zooms; stickers bounce.
styles.transitions: Whip pan or zoom punch.
styles.audio: Captions synced to transcript; zooms on emphasis words; beat-matched cuts.

styles.name: Psychedelic Poster
styles.look: 1960s concert-poster psychedelia: full-strength inks in vibrating complementary pairs, liquid churning ring bands, sunbursts, a mirror-symmetric eye-flower and bulbous melting lettering on worn poster stock.
styles.type: Melting bulbous display (Shrikhand), warped along curves.
styles.motion: Liquid rings churn, colors cycle, symmetry kaleidoscopes, letters wobble.
styles.transitions: Color cycle melt.
styles.audio: Ring churn speed with tempo; color cycles on bars; wobble on bass.

styles.name: Cosmic Nebula Mandala
styles.look: Deep-space nebula clouds with a sacred-geometry mandala of light at the center, star fields, frequency rings and glowing sigils.
styles.type: Spaced ethereal caps (Cinzel Decorative or Josefin Sans Thin).
styles.motion: Mandala rotates in counter-rotating rings; nebula drifts; rings ripple outward.
styles.transitions: Zoom through the mandala center.
styles.audio: Rings ripple on kicks; rotation speed with energy; frequency rings react to bands.
